user.title: Configuration
user.description: HACS Refresh allows you to schedule or manually trigger refreshes of all or selected installed HACS repositories.

data_description.automatic_refresh: When enabled, HACS Refresh runs automatically according to the selected days and times.
data_description.days: Select the days on which automatic refreshes should run.
data_description.times: Enter one or more times in 24-hour HH:MM format, separated by commas. Example: 03:00, 15:00.

error.invalid_time: Enter valid times using HH:MM format.
error.no_times: At least one refresh time is required.
error.too_many_times: A maximum of 10 refresh times can be configured.
error.times_too_close: Refresh times must be at least 10 minutes apart.

automatic_refresh_schedule_required.message: At least one day and one refresh time must be configured before automatic refresh can be enabled.

min_ha_version.message: Home Assistant {version} or newer is required.

refresh_in_progress.message: A HACS refresh is already in progress.

repositories_empty.message: At least one repository must be specified when using the `repositories` field.

repositories_invalid.message: The following repositories are unknown or not installed in HACS: {repositories}

service_not_loaded.message: HACS Refresh is not configured or loaded.

unexpected_refresh_error.message: Unexpected error while refreshing HACS repositories.

init.title: Configuration
init.description: Configure scheduled refreshes of all installed HACS repositories. Manual refreshes are always available through the HACS Refresh action.
